units.title: SG-6 · Characters, animations, game state, dialogue, inventory and persistence
Act: Add characters schema, animation resolver and Phaser character rendering
Act: Author opening dialogue branches in bedroom.yaml
Act: Add contextual action events for bed, computer, window and door
Act: Add secret-door-open object and strict save validation
Verify: Character schema, animation resolver and preload unit tests

tests.name: resolveCharacterAnimation and sceneSchema characters > walk: resolves the boy walk state to the boy-walk asset and walk animation
tests.title: resolves the boy walk state to character:boy-walk / walk
tests.scenario: Given the boy from bedroom.yaml, When resolving walk against the real manifest, Then it returns {asset: character:boy-walk, animation: walk}
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/characterAnimation.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: resolveCharacterAnimation and sceneSchema characters > interact: resolves the boy interact state to the boy-interact asset and interact animation
tests.title: resolves the boy interact state to character:boy-interact / interact
tests.scenario: Given the boy from bedroom.yaml, When resolving interact against the real manifest, Then it returns {asset: character:boy-interact, animation: interact}
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/characterAnimation.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: resolveCharacterAnimation and sceneSchema characters > falls back to idle when the spec has no walk entry
tests.title: falls back to idle when the spec has no walk entry
tests.scenario: Given a spec with only idle, When resolving walk, Then the idle reference is returned
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/characterAnimation.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: resolveCharacterAnimation and sceneSchema characters > falls back to idle when the walk asset is not in the manifest
tests.title: falls back to idle when the walk asset is not in the manifest
tests.scenario: Given walk points at character:missing, When resolving walk, Then the idle reference is returned
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/characterAnimation.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: resolveCharacterAnimation and sceneSchema characters > accepts the boy character in sceneSchema.parse
tests.title: accepts the boy character in sceneSchema.parse
tests.scenario: Given bedroom.yaml with the boy declaring idle, walk and interact, When parsed with sceneSchema, Then the boy character has all three animation states
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/characterAnimation.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: resolveCharacterAnimation and sceneSchema characters > rejects a character without animations.idle with a ZodError at characters.0.animations.idle
tests.title: rejects a character without animations.idle with a ZodError at characters.0.animations.idle
tests.scenario: Given the boy's idle animation is removed, When parsing with sceneSchema, Then a ZodError is thrown whose issue path includes characters.0.animations.idle
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/characterAnimation.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: resolveCharacterAnimation and sceneSchema characters > planPreload loads all three boy asset ids exactly once
tests.title: planPreload loads all three boy asset ids exactly once
tests.scenario: Given the parsed bedroom scene, When planning preload against the real manifest, Then character:boy, character:boy-walk and character:boy-interact are each in load exactly once
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/characterAnimation.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: BootScene character wiring > creates one sprite per scene character and plays its idle animation key
tests.title: creates one sprite per scene character and plays its idle animation key
tests.scenario: Given one boy character with idle in the manifest, When create() runs, Then one sprite is added and played with character:boy:idle
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneCharacters.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: BootScene character wiring > plays the boy interact animation when the character sprite is pressed
tests.title: plays the boy interact animation when the character sprite is pressed
tests.scenario: Given the boy sprite is created, When its pointerdown listener fires, Then play is called with character:boy-interact:interact
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneCharacters.test.ts --testTimeout=10000
tests.detail: Adapted: the step's objectClick emission is not the trigger in BootScene.createCharacter; the test drives the sprite POINTER_DOWN listener instead.

units.title: Verify: Opening dialogue progression unit tests

tests.name: dialogueProgression > opening dialogue > shows the boy's opening line with the two starting choices
tests.title: shows the boy's opening line with the two starting choices
tests.scenario: Given a fresh state built from the real bedroom scene, When the active node is read, Then its text and choice labels match the opening dialogue
tests.command: npx vitest run tests/dialogueProgression.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: dialogueProgression > opening dialogue > moves to the look-around branch and sets looked_around when the first choice is picked
tests.title: moves to the look-around branch and sets looked_around when the first choice is picked
tests.scenario: Given a fresh state, When choice index 0 is chosen, Then activeDialogue is 'look-around' and flags.looked_around is true
tests.command: npx vitest run tests/dialogueProgression.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: dialogueProgression > opening dialogue > moves to the explore branch and sets exploring when the second choice is picked on a fresh state
tests.title: moves to the explore branch and sets exploring when the second choice is picked on a fresh state
tests.scenario: Given a fresh state, When choice index 1 is chosen, Then activeDialogue is 'explore' and flags.exploring is true
tests.command: npx vitest run tests/dialogueProgression.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

tests.name: dialogueProgression > opening dialogue > ends the dialogue when the follow-up node's only choice is picked
tests.title: ends the dialogue when the follow-up node's only choice is picked
tests.scenario: Given the look-around node is active, When choice index 0 is chosen, Then activeDialogue is null
tests.command: npx vitest run tests/dialogueProgression.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

units.title: Verify: Object action state transition and inventory unit tests

tests.name: contextual actions > bed search adds old-key to the inventory
tests.title: bed search adds old-key to the inventory
tests.scenario: Given a fresh bedroom state, When performAction(bed, search), Then inventory is ['old-key']
tests.command: npx vitest run tests/objectActions.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: contextual actions > repeating bed search keeps a single old-key in the inventory
tests.title: repeating bed search keeps a single old-key in the inventory
tests.scenario: Given bed has been searched once, When bed search is repeated, Then inventory still holds one old-key
tests.command: npx vitest run tests/objectActions.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: contextual actions > old computer search sets the computer_on flag to true
tests.title: old computer search sets the computer_on flag to true
tests.scenario: Given a fresh bedroom state, When performAction(old-computer, search), Then flags.computer_on is true
tests.command: npx vitest run tests/objectActions.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: contextual actions > window inspect sets the window_seen flag to true
tests.title: window inspect sets the window_seen flag to true
tests.scenario: Given a fresh bedroom state, When performAction(window, inspect), Then flags.window_seen is true
tests.command: npx vitest run tests/objectActions.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: contextual actions > bookshelf search sets the secret_door_open flag to true
tests.title: bookshelf search sets the secret_door_open flag to true
tests.scenario: Given a fresh bedroom state, When performAction(bookshelf, search), Then flags.secret_door_open is true
tests.command: npx vitest run tests/objectActions.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: contextual actions > door leave on a fresh state returns the identical state object
tests.title: door leave on a fresh state returns the identical state object
tests.scenario: Given a fresh state without old-key, When performAction(door, leave), Then the same state reference is returned
tests.command: npx vitest run tests/objectActions.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: contextual actions > door leave sets door_unlocked after the bed has been searched for the key
tests.title: door leave sets door_unlocked after the bed has been searched for the key
tests.scenario: Given bed search has added old-key, When performAction(door, leave), Then flags.door_unlocked is true
tests.command: npx vitest run tests/objectActions.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

units.title: Verify: Persistence, restore and secret door re-entry unit tests

tests.name: keeps flags.secret_door_open true across a serialize/deserialize round trip
tests.title: deserializeState element validation > keeps flags.secret_door_open true across a serialize/deserialize round trip
tests.scenario: Given a state with secret_door_open true, When serialized and deserialized, Then the flag is still true
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/persistenceStrict.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: rejects an inventory that contains non-string elements with "Invalid game state: inventory"
tests.title: deserializeState element validation > rejects inventory with non-string elements
tests.scenario: Given a save with inventory [1], When deserialized, Then it throws 'Invalid game state: inventory'
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/persistenceStrict.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: rejects flags with non-boolean values
tests.title: deserializeState element validation > rejects flags with non-boolean values
tests.scenario: Given a save with flags {a:'x'}, When deserialized, Then it throws 'Invalid game state: flags'
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/persistenceStrict.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: rejects relationships with non-number values
tests.title: deserializeState element validation > rejects relationships with non-number values
tests.scenario: Given a save with relationships {a:'x'}, When deserialized, Then it throws 'Invalid game state: relationships'
tests.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/persistenceStrict.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: hides the open secret door before the bookshelf is searched
tests.title: secret door stays open > hides the open secret door before the bookshelf is searched
tests.scenario: Given a fresh game, When the view is read, Then secret-door-open is not in the view
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/secretDoorPersistence.test.tsx --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: shows the secret door after searching the bookshelf
tests.title: secret door stays open > shows the secret door after searching the bookshelf
tests.scenario: Given a fresh game, When act('bookshelf','search'), Then the flag is true and secret-door-open is in the view
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/secretDoorPersistence.test.tsx --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: keeps the flag and view unchanged after going to another scene and back
tests.title: secret door stays open > keeps the flag and view unchanged after going to another scene and back
tests.scenario: Given the door is open, When goto_scene hallway then bedroom is applied via store setState, Then the flag and view still include the door
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/secretDoorPersistence.test.tsx --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: restores the open secret door after unmount and remount
tests.title: secret door stays open > restores the open secret door after unmount and remount
tests.scenario: Given the door is open and the hook is unmounted, When remounted, Then the flag and view still include the door
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/secretDoorPersistence.test.tsx --testTimeout=10000

tests.name: starts a fresh game when the saved payload is corrupt
tests.title: secret door stays open > starts a fresh game when the saved payload is corrupt
tests.scenario: Given getItem returns '{bad', When useGame mounts, Then the flag is unset, activeDialogue is 'intro', and the door is hidden
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/secretDoorPersistence.test.tsx --testTimeout=10000

REQ · Persistent object states survive save, restore and re-entering the room
